title: 3 AI Tools You Missed: Reddit, Spotify, Lightroom 🤯
description:
3 new AI tools you might have missed this week. Reddit Reviews uses AI to sum up what Redditors say about about 10,000 products (rolling out in the US; brands can't pay to be featured). Spotify's AI DJ got nine new voices and a setting to turn off the talking between songs (Premium). And Adobe Lightroom's Open Eyes (beta) fixes a blink using another photo of the same person.

Which one would you try first? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Reddit, "Introducing Reddit Reviews" (November 10, 2026); Spotify, "Make Spotify's DJ Your Own With New Voices and Even More Control" (November 10, 2026); Adobe, Creative Cloud at Adobe MAX (November 10, 2026); The Next Web (November 10, 2026)
